newsitem.title: USA: Air Products sets Brazilian acquisition.
newsitem.headline: Air Products sets Brazilian acquisition.

text.p: Air Products and Chemicals Inc said Tuesday its Brazilian affiliate, Air Products Gases Industriais Ltda, has agreed to acquire the intangible assets of Quimica da Bahia's amines business for undisclosed terms.

Quimica da Bahia -- formerly Brazil's largest amines maker -- will continue to produce higher amines for Air Products at its production facility in the Camagari petrochemical complex in northeastern Brazil, Air Products said.

The company said it will sell the amines to customers in Argentina, Uruguay, Paraguay and Chile for use in applications that include herbicides, pharmaceuticals and water treatment chemicals. -- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.
